parts.name: Root
parts.description: The container with the state. It holds the open state, the input text, the selection, the filter, and the keyboard operation.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable id, from which the component makes its internal ARIA ids. Give one on a server.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops all of the user interaction.

props.name: pending
props.description: Shows the state of an asynchronous request in data-pending. While it is true, the trigger button and the clear button stop their operation.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the operation of the combobox, but stops the changes of the value.

props.name: value
props.description:
The selected value or values: one value in the single mode, and an array in the multiple mode.
You can bind it with `bind:value`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The selection at the start, for when the component controls the state.

props.name: controlledValue
props.description:
Give your own code full control of the selection. The component stops to write back to
`value`, and it reports only through `onChange`. Thus the parent can refuse a change: the
parent does not send the new value down. The default is off, because `bind:value` is the usual
case and it needs the write-back.

props.name: inputValue
props.description: The text in the input. You can bind it with `bind:inputValue`.

props.name: defaultInputValue
props.description: The text in the input at the start, for when the component controls the state.

props.name: controlledInputValue
props.description: Give your own code full control of the input text. Read `controlledValue`.

props.name: selectionBehavior
props.description: The result when the user selects an option that is already selected: 'toggle' removes the selection, and 'replace' keeps it.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: The selection mode: one selection, or more than one selection.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description:
Closes the popover after a selection. The default is true in the single mode, and false in the
multiple mode.

props.name: open
props.description: The open state of the popover. You can bind it with `bind:open`.

props.name: controlledOpen
props.description: Give your own code full control of the open state. Read `controlledValue`.

props.name: trigger
props.description: What opens the popover: 'focus', 'input', or 'press'. The default is 'press'.

props.name: filter
props.description: The function that filters the items locally. Set it to null to stop the local filter.

props.name: filterActionItems
props.description: Puts the items that have an `onAction` function into the local filter.

props.name: onInputChange
props.description: The component calls it when the text in the input changes.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The component calls it when the open state of the popover changes.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The component calls it when the selection changes.

props.name: items
props.description:
The array of the items. The component uses it to find the names of the selected values before
the options go into the DOM.

props.name: children
props.description: The combobox parts that you assemble.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the root group element.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name of the combobox group.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The id of the element that gives this combobox group its name.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the combobox is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus is inside the combobox.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the combobox has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-pending
dataAttributes.description: Present while the combobox is in a pending (busy) state.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the combobox is readonly.

parts.name: Input
parts.description: A text input with role="combobox". It keeps the text, the active descendant, and the keyboard operation correct with the root.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name of the input.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The id of the element that gives this input its name.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: The id of the element that describes this input, for example the instructions.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the input element.

dataAttributes.name: data-form-type
dataAttributes.description: Tells a password manager that the field is not a credential. The manager then ignores the field.

dataAttributes.name: data-lpignore
dataAttributes.description: Tells LastPass not to put its autofill overlay on the field. That overlay would cover the listbox.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: An optional button that opens and closes the popover. It does not take the focus from the input.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the trigger button.

props.name: children
props.description: Your own content for the trigger. If you give none, the component makes a chevron icon.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the popover is open.

parts.name: Button
parts.description: A second name for ComboBox.Trigger, for compatibility. In new code, use ComboBox.Trigger.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the trigger element.

props.name: children
props.description: Your own content for the trigger. If you give none, the component makes a chevron icon.

parts.name: Clear
parts.description: An optional button that removes the input text and the selection. It does not take the focus from the input. It is disabled when there is nothing to remove.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the clear button.

props.name: children
props.description: Your own content for the clear button. If you give none, the component makes an X icon.

parts.name: Popover
parts.description: The container of the options, which floats against the input group. It uses Popover.Root and Popover.Content in the non-modal mode.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the popover, usually ComboBox.List.

props.name: offset
props.description: The distance from the anchor element, on the main axis.

props.name: placement
props.description: The position against the anchor element.

props.name: shouldFlip
props.description: Moves the panel to the opposite side when the space is not sufficient.

props.name: boundaryElement
props.description: The element that gives the limits of the position.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the popover container.

props.name: nonModal
props.description:
Makes the popover non-modal. The user can then operate the page, the focus does not stay in
the panel, and the page scrolls.

props.name: shouldCloseOnInteractOutside
props.description: Closes the popover when the user clicks outside it.

props.name: shouldCloseOnEscape
props.description: Closes the popover when the user pushes the `Escape` key.

props.name: shouldCloseOnBlur
props.description: Closes the popover when the focus goes out of it. The default is true for a non-modal popover.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: The element, or the selector of the element, that gets the focus first in the modal mode.

parts.name: List
parts.description: The listbox of the options. ComboBox.Root holds the selection state and the selection mode. This part also accepts ListBox.Root props, for example class and emptyPlaceholder.

props.name: items
props.description:
The items, for a list that the component makes from an array. They replace the items of the
ComboBox context.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the listbox. From an array of items, it receives one item.

props.name: virtualizer
props.description:
Makes only the options near the viewport. The `virtualizer` prop of `ListBox` gives the two
conditions: all of the rows have the same height, and the list is the element that scrolls.

Without its own `items`, it uses the filtered items of the ComboBox. A list without a
virtualizer filters one item at a time, and that cannot work when most of the items are not in
the DOM.

props.name: header
props.description: The rows in the listbox above the options, for example a "Create …" action.

props.name: emptyPlaceholder
props.description: The content while the list is empty. It can be a string or a Snippet.

props.name: getItemKey
props.description:
Reads the key of an item. This is the same value as the `id` of `ListBox.Item`.

You need it only with `virtualizer`. Without it, a Shift range is measured over the options in
the DOM. In a virtualized list, those are only the rows near the viewport, thus the range
stops at the scroll position of the user.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: The keys of the items that must be disabled. The user cannot select them.

props.name: controlledValue
props.description:
Give your own code full control of the selection. The component stops to write back to
`value`, and it reports only through `onChange`. Thus the parent can refuse a change: the
parent does not send the new selection down. The default is off, because `bind:value` is the
usual case and it needs the write-back.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the listbox container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name of the listbox. A screen reader announces it.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description:
The id of an element that the user sees, and that gives the listbox its name. Use it in place
of `aria-label` when the list already has a heading.

props.name: disableFocusHandling
props.description: Stops the DOM focus control on the root container, for a composition with a virtual focus.

props.name: loop
props.description:
At the last item, the arrow keys move the focus to the first item, and at the first item, to
the last one.

props.name: typeahead
props.description: When the user types a character, the focus moves to the option whose text agrees with it.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: An option that the user can select. It has the combobox filter, the virtual focus, and the registration. It needs a unique id. For an item that does an action and does not select, use onAction.

props.name: onAction
props.description: The component calls it when the user activates this item as an action, and does not select it.

props.name: closeOnAction
props.description: Closes the popover after the `onAction` function runs.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of this item. The component uses it for the selection.

props.name: textValue
props.description: The text for the typeahead. If you give none, the component reads it from the content.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables this item. The user cannot select it.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the item element.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the item.

props.name: isFocusVisibleOverride
props.description: Replaces the focus-visible state.

props.name: onItemHoverStart
props.description: The component calls it when the pointer must move the logical focus to this item.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Replaces the pressed state. With this prop, the component uses your value and not its own.

parts.name: ItemIndicator
parts.description: The selection mark in a ComboBox.Item. The default is a check mark icon.

props.name: children
props.description: The content while the item is selected. The default is a check mark icon.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keeps the indicator in the DOM, for each selection state.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the indicator container.

dataAttributes.name: data-state
dataAttributes.description: "checked" while the item is selected, "unchecked" otherwise.

props.name: formatMessage
props.description: Makes the announced message from the number of the items that the user sees.

parts.name: Tags
parts.description: The container that makes a tag for each selected value, in the multiple mode. It has an optional mode that keeps the tags on one line.

props.name: children
props.description: The snippet that makes each tag. It receives { item: { value, label } }.

props.name: overflow
props.description:
An optional indicator for the tags that do not fit. With it, the tag row stays on one line.
The component makes no tag that does not fit, and it puts this snippet at the end with the
number of the hidden tags. The snippet also receives `visible` and `total`, thus you can show
a summary when no tag fits. Make one element in it.

Without `overflow`, the component makes each tag, and your styles decide how the row wraps.

props.name: reserve
props.description:
The horizontal space to keep free in the parent, in px, for an element beside the tags such as
the search input. Thus the calculation does not take the full row. The component uses it only
with `overflow`.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the tags container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name of the tag row. The default is `Selected values`.

parts.name: Tag
parts.description: One tag, for one selected value, in the multiple selection mode.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the tag. For the remove button, use ComboBox.TagRemove.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the combobox is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the tag is focused.

dataAttributes.name: data-tag-id
dataAttributes.description: The selected item id represented by the tag.

parts.name: TagRemove
parts.description: The button that removes its tag from the selection.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the button. The default is an X icon.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the remove button.

props.name: aria-label
props.description:
The accessible name of the button. The default is `Remove <tag label>`. Replace it to
translate the verb, or to name the tag with a different text. The default label is the raw
value when your code sets the selection and the option never goes into the DOM.
